claims.evidence: BaseRenderer._tokenize_prompt passes the text to the tokenizer and copies resulting input IDs; with fixed repeated ASCII sentence, encoding and output size grow with characters.
claims.scope: Fixed OPT tokenizer and repeated ASCII sentence. Predict affine growth in characters plus fixed overhead.
claims.uncertainty: General text can have different UTF-8 size, BPE segmentation, cache state and token count at equal character length; character count alone need not explain those.
claims.measurement_evidence: Within fixed ASCII workload tokenization grows with chars (90 chars ~0.481M, 2970 ~8.956M mean own instructions in point-01); first 45-char call ~0.991M vs repeated ~0.340M exposes missing cold state.

claims.evidence: InputProcessor._validate_model_input performs both max(prompt_ids) and min(prompt_ids). Other successful decoder-only checks are fixed work.
claims.scope: Nonempty text-token input, fixed tokenizer/model, valid IDs. Predict affine instructions in token count.
claims.uncertainty: Embeddings, multimodal loops, exceptions and tokenizer vocabulary initialization are outside the expression's scope.
claims.measurement_evidence: point-01 tokens42,252,662 have mean own instructions26370,92630,222109; point-02 agrees closely. Rough slope314 own instructions/token with fixed overhead. This dependency was predicted before measurement.

claims.evidence: OutputProcessor.add_request creates RequestState and an incremental detokenizer; FastIncrementalDetokenizer constructs DecodeStream(ids=request.prompt_token_ids), slow variant converts prompt IDs and extends a list.
claims.scope: New ordinary sampling requests, fixed detokenizer implementation and sampling options. Predict fixed plus token-length work; no growth with requested max_tokens value.
claims.uncertainty: Native DecodeStream implementation may only retain or partially process IDs; exact slope is uncertain. Existing request/streaming updates use a different branch.
claims.measurement_evidence: Own work grows in substantial part with prompt tokens, e.g. tokens42 ~41.8K and252 ~67.8K, but302 ~102.4K and662 ~129.8K with equal-state variation; affine sufficiency unestablished. Token dependency was predicted.

claims.evidence: EngineCore.preprocess_add_request builds Request; Request copies prompt_token_ids to _all_token_ids and calls block hashing.
claims.scope: Text-only sampling requests, no structured output or LoRA. Predict token-copy work plus symbolic admission.hash_blocks cost.
claims.uncertainty: Allocator variation and native initialization are not independently modeled.
claims.measurement_evidence: Source token-copy dependency remains; own means are nonmonotonic (252tokens96.6K,302tokens74.4K), so token count plus constant does not fully explain own work. Child hashing explains additional inclusive growth.

claims.expression: new_blocks = max(0, request.num_tokens // hash_block_size - len(request.block_hashes)); hashed_tokens = new_blocks * hash_block_size
claims.evidence: request_block_hasher iterates only newly complete hash blocks, slicing hash_block_size token IDs and hashing each block chained to the preceding hash.
claims.scope: Fixed hash algorithm, no multimodal/LoRA/embeddings. Predict fixed plus per-new-block and per-hashed-token CPU work; tail tokens below a complete block should not add hashing work.
claims.uncertainty: With fixed hash block size new_blocks and hashed_tokens are collinear, so their individual coefficients cannot be identified. Hash algorithm/content, salt and extra keys can change work. Function may also execute after admission for generated tokens; those invocations will be identified as out of admission scope.
claims.measurement_evidence: Admission child observations new_blocks0..5 and hashed_tokens0..640 have point-01 mean own instructions1.827K,46.819K,88.906K,132.769K,176.645K,221.097K. Growth with complete blocks was already predicted. Two variables remain collinear.

claims.expression: tokens = len(prompt.get('prompt_token_ids') or []); outputs = params.n; max_tokens = params.max_tokens or 0; resident = len(self.output_processor.request_states)
claims.evidence: LLMEngine.add_request validates and clones parameters, initializes output state and core request; fanout loops over params.n. Requested max_tokens is copied rather than iterated over; state maps use keyed operations.
claims.scope: Prepared decoder-only EngineInput, n=1 in workload. Predict fixed own overhead plus symbolic validation/output/core children; max_tokens and resident should not cause linear bulk scanning at admission.
claims.uncertainty: n fanout is untested by supported workload; dictionary resizing can cause discontinuities. Child work can depend on token count. Repeated passes may change caches or allocator states without changing these PCVs.
claims.measurement_evidence: Warm own cost stays near0.48M across resident0..15 and max_tokens1 vs4. First entry has48.7M versus0.492M repeated at exactly same declared state: completeness of original own interface contradicted. Fanout untested; no independently established resident coefficient.

experiment: One round with configurations reqs=4 passes=4,4 max_tokens=1; reqs=16 passes=16,16 max_tokens=1; reqs=16 passes=16,16 max_tokens=4. Prompt length varies within each config; request count and output budget change independently between configs. Repeated passes expose cold/warm variation. No inference region is marked.

revised_candidates.evidence: SamplingParams.verify -> _validate_logits_processors -> validate_logits_processors_parameters calls cached_load_custom_logitsprocs(None). The lru_cache loader calls importlib.metadata.entry_points(group=LOGITSPROCS_GROUP), which scans installed plugin metadata. Engine initialization calls uncached _load_custom_logitsprocs, leaving this request validation cache unfilled.
revised_candidates.scope: Fixed model_config.logits_processors=None, single process, cache not otherwise populated or cleared. currsize is an existing cache-state query at region entry; no region is replayed.
revised_candidates.uncertainty: Unverified causal attribution: this cache PCV was not recorded in round01. A second experiment recording cache state or separating validation/plugin discovery would be needed to establish how much first-call work it explains. With arbitrary cache keys currsize==0 does not detect all misses.

limitations: No additional rounds performed. No optimization. CPU instruction work only; elapsed workload times include inference and instrumentation.

Character/token size and request index are coupled by fixed prompt ordering; resident size and token length are not independently varied. Hash block size fixed128, n fixed1, no model/Unicode/LoRA/multimodal changes.
Hash helper is additionally invoked during generation; raw rows with empty parent are outside admission and excluded from admission conclusions.
Reported slopes and means from saved raw counters are descriptive, not final fitted coefficients; equal-state min/max variation is retained in evidence.csv.
